mathematical_contract.component_authority: Hypersolve publishes a primitive common-fiber polynomial only after it divides both authored equations exactly; both exact quotients remain in the recursive residual engine
mathematical_contract.closed_domain: the retained endpoint fibers each contain exactly one unit-interval root, and every lifted box-edge root is an authored endpoint
mathematical_contract.regularity: exact two-equation resultant replay proves the component shares no unit-square solution with either parameter derivative
mathematical_contract.topology: absence of retained-direction critical points and open-edge entry, together with one midpoint fiber root, proves exactly one graph over the closed retained interval
mathematical_contract.orientation: absence of lifted-direction critical points proves strict monotonicity; exact endpoint comparison selects same or reversed overlap orientation
mathematical_contract.branch: the selected signed-normal polynomial has no zero on the component and its exact midpoint sign accepts or discards the whole graph
mathematical_contract.residuals: after component removal, every remaining isolated candidate is projected and replayed through the same authoritative engine
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT uses exact rational component division, exact root isolation, exact resultant replay, exact critical-point exclusion, and exact sign predicates
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same proof graph; only inherited Hyperreal equality terminals may stop at 512 bits, and no approximate polynomial, range, point, or topology event is synthesized
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: multi-cell, nonmonotone, singular, boundary-coincident, unsupported coefficient-tower, or undecidable cases remain explicit Boundary or RealSign uncertainty

sampled_fiber_gcd_fast_path.algorithm: specialize both authored equations at exact integer fibers, compute exact univariate GCDs, scale each monic GCD by the lower-degree authored leading coefficient, interpolate only that low-degree polynomial family, remove the scale as exact polynomial content, and authorize the candidate only by exact division of both original bivariate equations
sampled_fiber_gcd_fast_path.fallback: a degree drop, inconsistent sampled degree, unsupported coefficient, failed interpolation, or failed exact division falls through to the complete subresultant scan
sampled_fiber_gcd_fast_path.policy: the speculative reconstruction is exact-rational and policy-independent; it cannot publish approximate evidence
sampled_fiber_gcd_fast_path.high_cofactor_fixture: H(t,u)=(6-3u)(t^2+t)+2u^2-8u divides authored systems of bidegrees (7,6) and (8,12); seven retained-u samples replace reconstruction of a degree-114 first subresultant
sampled_fiber_gcd_fast_path.memory: only degrees actually observed allocate sample buckets; specialized fibers are moved into the GCD instead of cloned
